result.topic_en: Solution of the three-dimensional wave equation for the condensation s by Poisson's spherical-mean formula, given initial values of s and its time derivative, applied to small air oscillations with velocity components u, v, w and a velocity potential φ.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial^2 s}{\partial t^2} = aa\left(\frac{\partial^2 s}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 s}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 s}{\partial z^2}\right)$
$t=0$ $s = f(x,y,z)$
$\frac{\partial s}{\partial t} = F(x,y,z) = -\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)_0$
$f=0,$ $s = \frac{1}{4\pi}\int_0^\pi\int_0^{2\pi} t \sin\vartheta\, d\vartheta\, d\varphi\, F(x+at\cos\vartheta, y+at\sin\vartheta\cos\varphi, z+at\sin\vartheta\sin\varphi)$
$+\frac{1}{4\pi}\frac{d}{dt}\int_0^\pi\int_0^{2\pi} t\sin\vartheta\, d\vartheta\, d\varphi\, f(x+at\cos\vartheta, y+at\sin\vartheta\cos\varphi, z+at\sin\vartheta\sin\varphi)$
1) $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = -aa\frac{\partial s}{\partial x}$
2) $\frac{\partial v}{\partial t} = -aa\frac{\partial s}{\partial y}$
3) $\frac{\partial w}{\partial t} = -aa\frac{\partial s}{\partial z}$
$\frac{\partial s}{\partial t}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}$
$x+at\cos\vartheta = x'$, $y+at\sin\vartheta\cos\varphi = y'$ $z[?]+at\sin\vartheta\sin\varphi = z'$
[Figure: coordinate axes with a ray from the origin to a point labelled $x', y', z'$ [?]]
$s=0.$ $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}=0$
$u=\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial x}$ $v=\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial y}$ $w=\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial z}$ $\varphi = \int u_0 dx + v_0 dy + w_0 dz = \Phi(x,y,z)$
$s=\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial t} = f(x,y,z)$
$\frac{\partial^2 \varphi}{\partial t^2} = aa\left(\frac{\partial^2 \varphi}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 \varphi}{\partial y^2}+\frac{\partial^2 \varphi}{\partial z^2}\right)$
$t=0$ $\varphi = \Phi(x,y,z)$
$\frac{\partial \varphi}{\partial t} = f(x,y,z)$
